observations: tests/test_tmux_integration.py: I extended the prefix+S side-pane test. It is renamed `..._and_a_stepper_that_never_splits_a_glyph_from_its_label`. It seeds 4 phases (done, in_progress, 2 planned, one with a long title). It asserts the pane is 40-60 columns wide (actual: 48). Every stepper line between the goal and the "phase 2/4" label starts with ✓, ● or ○. No line ends with a bare glyph. The long title "○ Wire every tmux binding…" ends with "…". The check runs on real `capture-pane` rows. I also extended the popup six-tabs test. It asserts the contiguous string "1 Active 2 2 Running 1 3 Ready 1 4 Waiting 0 5 Done 0 6 All 2" in the redrawn popup output. If the tabs wrapped to a second row, the popup border would break that string. At 48 columns the side pane wraps the tabs into rows of 3, as designed. README "Dashboard in tmux" section: the key table already listed `1`-`6`. I added a paragraph: one tab row whose labels start with the number key, wrap to 3, 2 or 1 per row in narrow panes, and the stepper wraps by width without splitting glyph from label and clips with "…". The tmux run stays near 60 s.
